description: Canonical route metadata for Alex Ford Adventures. Raw GeoJSON and encoded activity polylines preserve imported geometry; this file defines public ownership, provenance, privacy treatment, and explicit publication repairs for incomplete imported geometry.

activity-mtb-day-2026-05-24.note: The second imported segment ends with an incomplete encoded latitude and no matching longitude. Publication drops only that incomplete trailing point; all complete GPS coordinates are preserved.
